full_judgment: 19. We find from the record that the learned Judge of the trial Court, after considering SA Khatian (Exhibit 4) came to a specific finding that ejmali properties were not brought into hotchpotch and the plaintiff prayed for partial partition which is not at all maintainable. The learned Judge further came to a definite findings that the disputed kabala deeds as described in fourth schedule to the plaint (Exhibit 9 series) are not forged and, as such, the trial Court dismissed the suit.
